summary: V26.m callback edit route + tap fallback verified end-to-end. Backend 7/7 pytest passed: NEW GET /api/callbacks/{id} returns callback data (title, area, note, scheduled_at, contact_id) and 404 for missing; PUT persists note update; DELETE removes; 404 confirmed after delete. Frontend 5/5 tests passed on mobile viewport (390x844): (T1) tapping callback-open-{id} with linked contact_id routes to /contact/{contact_id} and shows comm-call button; (T2) tapping callback-open-{id} WITHOUT contact_id routes to /callback/{id} — edit screen shows title 'Modifica ritelefonata', cb-delete trash icon, pre-filled title/note/area, Save button labeled 'Salva modifiche'; changing note to 'MODIFIED_NOTE' + tap Save fires PUT and navigates back; (T3) reloaded Home shows MODIFIED_NOTE as subtitle after ' · '; (T4) tapping callback-toggle-{id} keeps URL on /home and toggles done=true via PUT (isolation confirmed — no bubble to row Pressable); (T5) delete via cb-delete + auto-accepted confirm → callback GET returns 404 and row disappears from Home. No red screens, no blocking errors. Ignored benign shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings per request.
critical_code_review_comments: callback/[id].tsx correctly re-exports NewCallbackScreen; NewCallbackScreen uses useLocalSearchParams and treats id!=='new' as edit mode with GET/PUT/DELETE — clean pattern, no duplication.
home.tsx CallbackRow onOpen fallback (`if (cb.contact_id) router.push(/contact/...); else router.push(/callback/{callback_id})`) is exactly the required fix and works for both scenarios.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5: row-with-contact nav, row-without-contact edit, save updates, note reflected in home, toggle isolation, delete via edit)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only — 1 contact + 2 callbacks created & cleaned up per test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V26.m callback tap fallback + edit route (GET/PUT/DELETE) fully verified. TestIDs: callback-open-{id}, callback-toggle-{id}, cb-delete, cb-title, cb-note, cb-save. Edit route: /callback/{id} where id!='new' switches NewCallbackScreen into edit mode.
rca_of_issue: V26.l addressed row tap for callbacks WITH contact_id. Remaining gap: callbacks with contact_id=null (quick reminders) had a no-op tap. V26.m fixes this by (a) adding fallback router.push(`/callback/${cb.callback_id}`) in home.tsx CallbackRow onOpen, (b) new dynamic route /callback/[id].tsx that re-exports NewCallbackScreen, (c) enhancing NewCallbackScreen to detect editId via useLocalSearchParams and to GET/PUT/DELETE via the new `GET /api/callbacks/{callback_id}` backend endpoint. All verified working.
